description: Source file containing helper functions for extracting device and endpoint resources, including conversions to boolean and float, used in simplified object creation within a device management SDK.

methods.name: extractDeviceResource
methods.description: Extracts a resource value from a device object, returning a copy or default if not found.

methods.name: extractEndpointResource
methods.description: Extracts a resource value from an endpoint object, returning a copy or default if not found.

methods.name: extractEndpointResourceAsBool
methods.description: Extracts a resource from an endpoint and converts it to a boolean, returning default if not available.

methods.name: extractEndpointResourceAsFloat
methods.description: Extracts a resource from an endpoint and converts it to a float, returning default if conversion fails.
